obfuscation_indicators: potential for further new virus variants
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and well quantified, including sales changes, store counts, cost pressures, liquidity, and supply-chain finance balances. Risk tone is cautiously positive but highlights material uncertainty from COVID-19, inflation, freight and wage costs, supply-chain congestion, and reliance on stimulus-supported demand. Liquidity is presented as adequate for at least 12 months, though several forward-looking assumptions remain uncertain.
